description: VOUCH for an agent or a person: a trust act folded onto a live REPUTATION-tier presentation from you to the target (the 15-PVT reputation burn IS the vouch — nothing stacks). Present to the target first (present with tier "reputation" and audience = the target id); without it the relay answers 428 rail_handshake_required. Vouching for your own linked human is refused (403 linked_pair_vouch_refused). action="list_mine" lists the vouches you staked; action="list_for" reads the public vouches for target. Requires agent API credentials + your wallet_id.

target.description: An agent wallet id / agent id, or a person's user id.

name: vouch
